title.zh: 公式预览移到公式上方

body.en: The live preview of the formula you are editing now appears just above it, so it no longer covers the lines below.
body.zh: 正在编辑的公式的实时预览现在显示在它的正上方，不再遮住下面的内容。

title.en: Annotations land on the right words
title.zh: 批注落在正确的文字上

body.en: A note's mark on the PDF now covers the same words as its source, its pin sits in the margin, the empty list is a centred drawing, and the toolbar shows the note count beside its icon.
body.zh: PDF 上的批注标记现在覆盖与源文件相同的文字，图钉移到页边，空列表显示为居中的插图，工具栏在图标旁显示批注数量。

body.en: The Proofread card scrolls into view, after a successful build the Build panel docks under the PDF instead of floating over it, Overleaf collaborators' names show briefly instead of always, and actions that need a selection say so.
body.zh: 校对卡片会自动滚动到可见位置，编译成功后编译面板会停靠在 PDF 下方而不是浮在上面，Overleaf 协作者的名字只短暂显示，需要先选中文字的操作也会给出提示。

fixes.en: "Save and revise now" revises only the note it saves.
fixes.zh: “保存并立即修改”现在只修改它保存的那条批注。

fixes.en: Opening a sheet no longer rewrites the file or adds an edit to History.
fixes.zh: 打开表格不再改写文件，也不会在历史中留下一条编辑记录。

fixes.en: ⇧-click Build cleans the project before building again.
fixes.zh: ⇧-点击“编译”会先清理项目再重新编译。

fixes.en: Jumping between the PDF and the source keeps working after the project folder moves.
fixes.zh: 项目文件夹移动后，PDF 与源文件之间的跳转仍然可用。

fixes.en: Borders and focus rings are no longer cut off at the edge of a scrolling list, the titlebar starts at the edge when the window lights are hidden, and the Build button is centred.
fixes.zh: 边框和焦点环不再在滚动列表的边缘被截断，隐藏窗口按钮时标题栏从最左侧开始，“编译”按钮也居中了。

fixes.en: Tabs, setup, the command palette, Check references, History, Annotations and dialogs are tidier, and lists use quieter punctuation that follows your language.
fixes.zh: 标签页、安装引导、命令面板、检查引用、历史、批注和各个对话框更整洁，列表改用更安静、随界面语言变化的标点。

fixes.en: The browser demo shows Overleaf, Add papers, History, Versions and Rewrite honestly, and its narrow dark page is fixed.
fixes.zh: 浏览器演示如实呈现 Overleaf、添加论文、历史、版本和改写功能，窄屏深色页面的问题也已修复。

fixes.en: The app starts with less code to load.
fixes.zh: 应用启动时需要加载的代码更少了。
